# Sephiria Wiki

> Independent fan reference for Sephiria (TEAM HORAY, released 2026-07-31).
> Every guide lists the sources it was verified against. Anything not confirmed is
> marked "still to verify" rather than guessed.

## Game facts
- Name: Sephiria
- Developer / Publisher: TEAM HORAY / TEAM HORAY
- Release date: 2026-07-31
- Platforms: Windows, macOS
- Genres: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG
- Official store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2436940/

## Sections
- https://sephiriawiki.site/guides/ — Beginner route, co-op, Hard Mode and PC setup.
- https://sephiriawiki.site/weapons/ — All six weapon classes and how their upgrades branch.
- https://sephiriawiki.site/artifacts/ — The inventory grid, Tablets, and why placement matters.
- https://sephiriawiki.site/bosses/ — The six chapters and what waits at the end of each.

## Editorial policy
This site does not publish item values, boss mechanics, or names it has not verified.
Pages with unverified areas say so explicitly in a "still to verify" section.
